snippet.title: KINGDOM HEARTS IV - Extended D23 2026 Coco Trailer
snippet.description:
KINGDOM HEARTS IV Launches in Late 2027!
A brand-new adventure awaits as the world of Disney and Pixar's Coco joins KINGDOM HEARTS IV.

Discover exciting new features, including action-packed sequences where you can play as Donald and Goofy, as well as an exploration segment following King Mickey as he searches for clues to the whereabouts of the missing Sora.

KINGDOM HEARTS IV is now available to wishlist on PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox ON PC, Nintendo Switch™ 2, Steam, and Epic Games Store.

Follow us to keep up to date with everything Kingdom Hearts related: 
X (previously Twitter): x.com/kingdomhearts   
Instagram: instagram.com/kingdomhearts   
Facebook: facebook.com/kingdomhearts   
YouTube: youtube.com/kingdomhearts  

 ---

As the KINGDOM HEARTS series approaches its 25th anniversary, a new adventure begins.
